name: Data360 Beast
description: Portable Salesforce Data 360 execution system with a Beast router, 16 specialist skills, docs-on-demand, a preflight contract, Think-Act-Prove-Learn operating model, phase proof matrix, limits-source precedence, OpenAPI-first API lookup, public model-gallery DMO design guidance, RAG/search-index/retriever guidance, tested proof ledger evidence, validation rules, and an optional Salesforce sf-skills Data 360 execution companion.
sourceHierarchy: User-provided org, files, data space, API version, and business goal
Official Salesforce docs fetched on demand
User-supplied or locally available Data 360 Connect API OpenAPI spec
Data360 Beast proof ledger and scorecard

executionModel.principle: Beast is not only a knowledge system; it is an execution system rooted in proven knowledge with proof and learning loops.
executionModel.outcome: The skill outcome should be execution-ready for the target org, not just advice.
executionModel.executionPromise: Execute in any authorized, compatible Data 360 org after preflight confirms org, data space, permissions, available tools, and mutation approval.

liveTestedAreas: data action target and data action create
search index and calculated insight list
ragGuidance: ADL fast path versus manual RAG setup
search index source path and DMO/UDMO selection
field roles: index, prepend, filter, return, and ranking
chunking tradeoffs for retrieval versus augmentation
hybrid versus vector search cost and relevance tradeoffs
dynamic prefilters for record, language, entitlement, product, and geography
prompt grounding, fallback behavior, and source ID preservation
Flow and Apex fallbacks for advanced filters and pro-code SQL
RAG debug chain and evaluation metrics
knownCaveats: Use current Data 360 Limits and Guidelines before legacy Customer Data Platform limits; follow Data Services Billable Usage Types when current docs route there
DBT segment create used includeDbt.models.models[] successfully
Data stream formula fields use the Data 360 formula library, not Query SQL
The public Data 360 model gallery is a normalized subject-area map for anchor DMO, grain, and relationship-path design

ADL is a fast path for uploaded files and Knowledge Articles; use manual RAG setup when source coverage, chunking, embeddings, dynamic filters, return fields, custom SQL, or access checks need more control
Hybrid search is useful when exact terms and semantic similarity both matter, but it is not a category lookup engine and has cost/latency impact
No-code retrievers have simple filter and result-count limits; use Flow/Apex/Query SQL for nested filters, post-filters, majority-vote classification, custom joins, or record-access checks
Query, transform, segment, analytics, activation, and orchestration surfaces can use different validation paths
Data 360 API / Direct API uses tenant-specific token exchange and endpoint handling, unlike Connect REST API and Apex ConnectApi
Data kits are the central deploy/package abstraction for Data 360 metadata; raw data is not packaged
Salesforce sf-skills Data 360 companion skills are an optional sf data360 execution layer, not official Data 360 documentation and not a replacement for sf-docs
External data architecture should choose ingestion, live query, accelerated query, file federation, or hybrid before implementation
DBT segment readback can normalize to includeDbt.models[]
Approximate segment count can fail when the feature is disabled
Segment member retrieval depends on a delta window
External activation destinations and search-index creation need enabled assets before proof-ledger promotion
datacloud-mcp-query is optional for retrieve-plane SQL/list/describe operations and does not replace d360-mcp-server for broad Connect API work
publicBoundary: No raw Salesforce Help exports, generated caches, lab data, raw Labs payload dumps, credentials, or org-specific metadata are published.
